name: What should I prepare for my first nutrition coaching session?
description: Before your first session, consider tracking your food intake for a few days, have your fitness goals in mind, and prepare any questions you have for your coach

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare for my first nutrition coaching session?

acceptedAnswer.text: For your first nutrition coaching session, it's helpful to come prepared with a general understanding of your current eating habits and any specific fitness or health goals you have. You might also consider tracking your food intake for a few days prior to the session, as this can provide valuable insights for your coach. Having a list of questions or concerns ready will also help maximize the effectiveness of your initial consultation, allowing your coach to tailor their approach more effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before your first session, consider tracking your food intake for a few days, have your fitness goals in mind, and prepare any questions you have for your coach.
